tour.text: This is your safe home base. Prepare here, then leave through a portal to start an adventure. A portal is a magical doorway.
This crystal is your travel menu. Use it to jump straight to places you can already visit. New places become available as you complete the story.
Briar Town is the first part of the main story. Walk up to this doorway and use Interact when you are ready to help your neighbors.
Complete Briar Town to open the next story doorway. Each completed region opens the next part of the journey. You can come back here between adventures.
Spend gold on equipment, or sell items you do not need. Equipment changes how much damage you deal or withstand.
Your bag holds the equipment you collect. Open it to compare items and choose what to wear. Press Tab / B to open your bag from anywhere.
Combine spare equipment to make stronger equipment. Open the forge to see which items can be combined and what you can use at your level.
Change your name, face and colors. Choose class outfits, capes and cosmetic trails. These change your look, not your strength.
Choose a different fighting class, such as Warrior or Mage. You can also change the skills and automatic bonuses you have chosen.
Companions are animals that travel and fight beside you. Rescue the dogs in the Black Woods to start buying and training companions here.
Look at your reflection in the glass. Use the mirror to inspect your outfit and equipment up close.
Try your attacks safely and practice against enemies. Inside, the bestiary is a guide to enemy names, attacks and where they live.
Fight repeated waves of enemies to earn gold, experience and equipment. Come here when you want to grow stronger before continuing the story.
Try to escape a prison dungeon. When an attempt ends, spend the gold you earned on permanent upgrades for future attempts. This has its own saves; it does not change your story adventure.
Set up a practice battle against computer opponents or other players. Choose equipment for the match; your normal adventure equipment stays safe.
Fight powerful bosses one after another. This optional challenge is for when you want a harder fight.
Race through a jumping course against the clock. Try to beat your best time. This activity does not give equipment rewards.
Find five Rift Shards in one story region to open its special challenge here. Rift Shards are hidden crystals. Beat the challenge to learn a new fighting class.
